answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in crystal, checked in zephyr, and forge makes public each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 8 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 48 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
